stage.name: Peak Deviation
stage.description: Your journey is full of forks in the road that may affect you or even others. No matter which path you take, you must bear the consequences of your choice.
stage.source: mode level file; no stage_table row

pyric_originium_slug.name: Pyric Originium Slug
pyric_originium_slug.flavourText: A wild infected creature, the final stages of infection having led them to burn even hotter. Their fluids, hot as magma, melt even their own bodies. Once cooled, beautiful patterns can be found in the pools they leave behind.
abilities: Attacks deal Burn

elite_wasteland_robber.name: Elite Wasteland Robber
elite_wasteland_robber.flavourText: An elite member of a bandit gang operating in the wastelands using stolen weapons. Now leading a small group of subordinates, they have kept their plundering habits and are even greedier than their henchmen.
abilities: Can appear in the battlefield
Prioritizes attacking Holy Statue
Steals 1 DP from allied Operators after several attacks

tiacauh_impaler_adept.name: Tiacauh Impaler Adept
tiacauh_impaler_adept.flavourText: Warriors who have gained greater proficiency in using thrown weapons due to training, and boast greater lethality. However, due to the weight of their weapons, their range hasn't really improved.

mine_drudge.name: Mine Drudge
mine_drudge.flavourText: A familiar sight in mine shafts for millennia. Laborers have always propped up the pinnacles of civilization with their rugged hands, but found their own feet mired in the mud of the label 'uncivilized.'
abilities: Deals more damage when attacking resources

mossback_beast.name: Mossback Beast
mossback_beast.flavourText: A beast with moss growing on its back, appearing round and gentle but it is actually fierce with a terrible temper. The moss on its body has a hemostatic effect, and it will eat it when injured.
abilities: Normally does not attack, but counters when attacked
Gradually restores HP over time

tiacauh_shaman.name: Tiacauh Shaman
tiacauh_shaman.flavourText: These extremely rare Arts users from Acahualla have a deeper understanding of Originium Arts. With more threatening Arts in their arsenal and years of medical experience, they are a force to be reckoned with if allowed to approach up-close.
abilities: Gains DEF when blocked, and deals high Physical damage with melee attacks

raging_direswine.name: Raging Direswine
raging_direswine.flavourText: A variety of Direswine extremely easy to anger, they dominate areas near water sources with great swagger. If one is enraged, it will indiscriminately rampage about with a madness sufficient to lay anything in the vicinity low.
abilities: Can only be blocked by units with at least 2 Block
Gradually accelerates when charging, dealing damage based on Movement Speed to any target it passes through or is blocked by

bounty_hunter_crossbowman_captain.name: Bounty Hunter Crossbowman Captain
bounty_hunter_crossbowman_captain.flavourText: A bounty hunter adept at attacking from long-range. A little skilled, with some notoriety. New bounties don't show up every day, so why not earn some extra money in their free time?
abilities: Can appear in the battlefield
Prioritizes attacking Holy Statue
After several attacks, the next attack deals splash damage to a cross area surrounding the target and steals DP equivalent to the number of targets hit

bounty_hunter_disruptor_captain.name: Bounty Hunter Disruptor Captain
bounty_hunter_disruptor_captain.flavourText: A bounty hunter who uses melee weapons and Originium Arts to intimidate others. New bounties don't show up every day, so why not earn some extra money in their free time?
abilities: Can appear in the battlefield
Deals Arts damage
Every Disruptor Captain on the field will reduce Max DP by a certain amount

tiacauh_champion.name: Tiacauh Champion
tiacauh_champion.flavourText: An incredibly formidable Tiacauh warrior, with the qualifications to become a Warchief. These warriors harbor great pride in their combat abilities, and live for the thrill of the duel no matter where they are. Their single-mindedness allows them to shrug off all outside interference.
abilities: When blocked, this unit will only receive damage from the unit blocking it, and the DEF of both units is decreased.

luminous_fowlbeast.name: Luminous Fowlbeast
luminous_fowlbeast.flavourText: A small creature that can only be seen far from nomadic cities. With a flutter of its wings, it escapes once more into the shadows.
abilities: Upon taking damage, becomes Invulnerable and cannot move for a period of time

leporibeast_shorthorn.name: Leporibeast Shorthorn
leporibeast_shorthorn.flavourText: A herbivorous beast commonly found almost anywhere in the wild. It has small but sharp horns and is not aggressive, but will run and jump to avoid attacks when frightened. The meat is very tender.
abilities: After being attacked, runs away a random distance and rests for a period of time

lush_mossback_beast.name: Lush Mossback Beast
lush_mossback_beast.flavourText: A beast with moss all over its body, easily agitated compared to others of its kind because of tiny, hard-to-remove bugs hiding in its vegetation. The moss grows back extremely quickly, and it will sometimes eat some even when uninjured.
abilities: Normally does not attack, but counters when attacked
Gradually restores HP over time

leporibeast_longhorn.name: Leporibeast Longhorn
leporibeast_longhorn.flavourText: A herbivorous beast commonly found almost anywhere in the wild. It has grown large horns, but will still run away on reflex, jumping even higher and faster. The meat is very tender.
abilities: After being attacked, runs away a random distance and rests for a period of time
